about: The agreement gate's rules as cases (README, "The agreement gate"). Every platform's gate runs these against its own implementation: stored is what the device holds under the manifest's storageKey, accept is agreed to in order, and pending and storedAfter are what must follow.

cases.name: a first launch asks for every document, in manifest order
each document needs its own agreement
agreeing to both opens the app
a new version asks again for that document only
unreadable storage counts as nothing agreed
a stored value that is not a version string does not count
agreeing records the version that was shown
agreeing to a document the manifest does not list changes nothing
agreements to documents no longer listed are dropped on the next write
